coordination_amendments.missing_label_sensitivity: Full denominator retained; unrestricted NOT_IDENTIFIED; hypothetical symmetric underlying-movement bounds with L in [.05,.10,.25,.50,1.00] percentage points plus tipping-point diagnostics; no imputed observed value.
